title: Wireless earbuds
text: Battery easily lasts a full workday and they pair instantly. The case feels flimsy though, and the left bud sometimes cuts out on calls.

title: Budget blender
text: Died after three smoothies. The motor smelled like burning plastic and the refund took five weeks. Avoid.

title: Standing desk
text: Took 40 minutes to assemble, motor is quiet, and it holds two monitors without wobbling. Worth every rupee.

title: Novel
text: The first half drags, but the last hundred pages are some of the best writing I've read this year.

title: Phone charger
text: It charges my phone. Nothing special, nothing wrong.
